subject: Activation Conductor: tenant ops and initial API/keying checklist
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@luminahealth.com>, Implementation Team <implementation@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Activation Conductor: tenant ops and initial API/keying checklist

Hi Sara —

Congrats again on the go‑live target next month. Per our CS handoff conversation, I’m leading the activation conductor for Lumina’s initial workspace and want to align on the first‑mile checklist so we can avoid last‑minute gate blockers. I’ve attached a working tenant_seed_matrix.xlsx (seed accounts, admins, and service account names) and the Lumina oncall list.

High level asks from Redwood for a smooth activation:
- Confirm list of admin users who need org‑admin and billing visibility (we’ll seed admin service accounts).
- Confirm project/namespace naming convention (we recommend lumina-prod, lumina-staging).
- Decide whether you want Redwood to generate service API keys or you’ll bring your own KMS (we support customer KMS via HSM).
- Provide a single point of contact for SSO / IdP mapping and a devops contact for ephemeral IP whitelisting.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm admin roster and desired project names by EOD Thursday 12/3.
2) Ben will create the tenant and seed service accounts on Redwood’s side (can do within 24 hours of confirmation).
3) Marissa will run the initial smoke tests and share URLs and token usage guidance.

If you prefer a quick 20‑minute call to run through the spreadsheet, I’m available Wednesday 11–1pm PT.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: tenant_seed_matrix.xlsx, lumina_oncall_contacts.pdf

From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@luminahealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Implementation Team <implementation@luminahealth.com>, DevOps <devops@luminahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Activation Conductor: tenant ops and initial API/keying checklist

Thanks Rachel —

This looks good. Quick answers:
- Admin roster: I’ve attached a small CSV with three admins (Sara Liu, Aaron Patel, Mei Chen). Aaron will be the primary billing contact.
- Naming convention: prefer lumina-prod / lumina-staging as you suggested.
- KMS: we plan to bring our KMS (Azure Key Vault). We’ll need instructions for integrating HSM/KMS with Redwood.
- SSO: I’ll loop in our SSO engineer (cc’d) to arrange SAML metadata exchange.

We can do the 20‑minute call Wednesday at 12:30pm PT.

—Sara
Head of Implementation
Lumina Health

Attachment: lumina_admins_v1.csv

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Activation Conductor: tenant ops and initial API/keying checklist

Hi all —

I’ll own the tenant creation and service account seeding once Sara confirms the CSV. A couple of implementation details for Lumina’s team to confirm before I create resources:

1) Service account naming: we will create two service accounts per environment: "lumina-svc-gen" (API client) and "lumina-svc-admin" (automation for key rotation).
2) API key lifecycle: Redwood issues initial keys as plaintext for first install — we strongly recommend applying your KMS wrap policy within 48 hours. If you want us to generate wrapped keys directly against Azure Key Vault, please provide the vault resource id + principal (we’ll only request minimal permissions).
3) Quota expectations: for lumina-prod, what concurrent token QPS do you expect? Our default seed will be 100 QPS; we can scale after baseline traffic measurements.

If the above looks correct I’ll proceed after the Wednesday call and post the tenant creation ticket with resource names.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@luminahealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 12:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Activation Conductor: tenant ops and initial API/keying checklist

Sara / team —

Short note to confirm what I’ll validate during the smoke pass once Ben seeds the tenant:
- Admin login + SSO probe for the three admin accounts (verify role mappings).
- Service account token generation and a demo call to the /generate endpoint.
- Basic model inference end‑to‑end: sample prompt, streaming check, and retry behavior for transient errors.
- Verify audit logs for first 24 hours are present (retention settings set to 30 days by default).

I’ll attach quick runbook notes to the tenant ticket. If you have any special compliance checklist items (logging destinations, log forwarding) say so now and I’ll include them.

—Marissa
Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@luminahealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 09:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Activation Conductor: tenant ops and initial API/keying checklist

Hi team —

Few operational notes on roles and KMS integration based on similar accounts:
- When Lumina provides Azure Key Vault details we ask for an SPN with wrap/unwrap permissions only. We will not store unwrapped keys in our database.
- Please confirm if any user needs the "billing_admin" role; that role is separate from org admins and required for cost dashboards.
- We will create a secondary service account for ingestion jobs if Lumina plans to use batch embedding pipelines — please indicate whether that should be included in the seed.

I’ve added two columns to the tenant_seed_matrix: billing_role and include_batch_svc. Sara, if you can fill those in on the CSV we’ll be set.

Monica Patel
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@luminahealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, DevOps <devops@luminahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Activation Conductor: tenant ops and initial API/keying checklist

Thanks everyone —

We filled the CSV and added the billing_role flag. DevOps provided the Azure vault resource id (attached) and a service principal for Redwood to use for key wrapping. We’ve set include_batch_svc = yes for lumina-prod.

Please proceed with tenant creation this week. We’ll join the call tomorrow at 12:30pm PT to walk through the smoke checklist.

Sara Liu
Head of Implementation
Lumina Health
